column4: Somehow, you also became its content team.
Prism learns your brand and your voice,
then plans your month across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and TikTok.
Every post is written for its channel.
and turns ideas into Reels and TikToks.
Your team reviews and approves, in one place.
so you can get back to the work only you can do.
Founders, shop owners, brands and agencies.
